_comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for live squad state. Read by squad_state.py. TEAM_CHANGE_LOG.md is the human narrative. Update BOTH after every actioned transfer. LEDGER NOTE, 7 Sep 2026 (GW4 transfer): O.Dango was recorded here at £6.5m but sold LIVE at £6.4m - a real price fall, so the £0.1m is a genuine loss of team value, not a bookkeeping error. squad_value+bank therefore moves 100.1 -> 100.0. THREE unrealised drifts remain and are deliberately NOT reconciled into this ledger (per the weekly-brief runbook: flag drift, never silently absorb it): VERIFIED AGAINST THE LIVE SITE 7 Sep 2026 - Mbeumo £8.0m->£7.9m, Thiago £8.0m->£7.9m, Shaw £4.5m->£4.4m. The live site reports Squad value £98.4m against this file's £98.7m, and those three account for the full £0.3m. DO NOT treat that £0.3m as spendable, and do not reconcile it into squad_value here - the ledger is bought_for-based by design. The live BANK matched this file exactly at £1.3m, so nothing in the GW4 transfer was mispriced. Root cause is roadmap B1 (price forecasting), gate GW3, still not built - now overdue. Previous correction 2 Sep 2026 (Sarr/João Pedro) preserved in TEAM_CHANGE_LOG.md.
as_at_note: SYNCED TO THE LIVE SITE 18 Oct 2026 (GW7 locked; GW8 deadline Fri 23 Oct 17:30 UTC). This file had stood at GW5 since 17 Sep - the GW6 and GW7 team changes were made directly on the FPL site and never recorded here, so the VM optimiser was scoring a stale squad (it recommended Schade -> Tavernier, a move already made). Back-filled from the FPL API: GW6 no transfers (captain Mbeumo, Virgil in the XI, Szoboszlai benched injured). GW7, 16 Oct 2026 23:36 BST, 2 free transfers, 0 pts: Szoboszlai OUT (sold £6.9m) -> E.Le Fée IN (£5.7m); Schade OUT (sold £6.1m) -> Tavernier IN (£6.1m). Bank £0.5m -> £1.7m, matching the live site exactly. Captain Tavernier, vice Gabriel. Virgil to the bench (bench 1), Justin into the XI. Szoboszlai's £0.1m sale below his recorded £7.0m is a real loss of team value, not a bookkeeping error. PREVIOUS: GW5, 17 Sep 2026 - Van de Ven -> Calafiori, captain Mbeumo; preserved in TEAM_CHANGE_LOG.md.

squad.name: Raya
squad.selected_on: 19 clean sheets, best xGC in the league (0.74). Unchanged since 9 Aug.

squad.name: Calafiori
squad.selected_on: IN for Van de Ven, 17 Sep 2026 (GW5), 1 free transfer, 0 pts cost. VM optimiser (HEAD 0a7a709, shrunk, quarantine ON, start-weighted xP/GW): +0.95 xP/GW, 5-GW net +4.7. Start rate 83% blended (38% last season, 4 of 4 starts this season). injury_report available.
squad.selected_on_caveat: The case rests on the start-rate jump: 4 of 4 starts may be Saliba injury cover rather than a settled role. Third Arsenal player (Raya, Gabriel) - concentrated clean-sheet risk. Revisit when Saliba returns.

squad.name: Gabriel
squad.selected_on: xGC 0.72, 18 clean sheets, 23.7 bps/90, xbonus90 0.82 (3rd-highest DEF in the pool). Unchanged since 9 Aug. Was CAPTAIN 28 Aug-3 Sep (GW2); armband moved to B.Fernandes 4 Sep 2026 (GW3, Sylvan's own call) - Arsenal host Chelsea GW3, a tougher clean-sheet fixture than the Villa one Gabriel was captained into.

squad.name: Justin
squad.selected_on: First substitute. 100% starts, xP_adj 3.64 - the most valuable autosub in the squad. Unchanged since 9 Aug.

squad.name: B.Fernandes
squad.selected_on: xGI/90 0.68, highest in the game. xbonus90 1.11, 2nd-highest in the pool. 100% starts. CAPTAIN, 4 Sep 2026 (GW3, moved from Gabriel) - Sylvan's own call. captaincy_odds (with intel) actually had O'Reilly ahead on E[pts]/P(haul)/P(blank), but that lead runs partly through unsourced ROLE_INTEL fence rows; B.Fernandes was the fully data-driven runner-up (E[pts] 5.99, P(haul) 15.6%, no ROLE_INTEL dependency).

squad.selected_on: IN for Szoboszlai, 16 Oct 2026 (GW7), free transfer, 0 pts. Szoboszlai sold live at £6.9m (recorded £7.0m - a real £0.1m fall), injured 0% at the time. Sylvan's own move, made on the FPL site and not run through the brief; back-filled into this file 18 Oct 2026 from the FPL API transfer history.

squad.name: Tavernier
squad.selected_on: IN for Schade, 16 Oct 2026 (GW7), free transfer, 0 pts. Schade sold live at £6.1m (bought £6.0m, half of a £0.2m rise). CAPTAIN GW7. The GW5 brief had already priced Schade -> Tavernier as the second leg of a -4 line (+1.88 xP/GW with Calafiori). Sylvan's own move, made on the FPL site; back-filled 18 Oct 2026 from the FPL API transfer history.

squad.selected_on: xGI/90 0.58, delta -3.0 - underperforming his chances. Unchanged since 9 Aug.

squad.name: Calvert-Lewin
squad.selected_on: 14 goals, xGI/90 0.55, delta -0.6 at £6.0m. Unchanged since 9 Aug.

squad.name: Thiago
squad.selected_on: xGI/90 0.62, 22 goals, 100% starts, xP_adj 5.26. VICE (was captain) - captaincy_odds 28 Aug has João Pedro ahead on both E[pts] and P(haul) with intel applied.

squad.name: João Pedro
squad.selected_on: xbonus90 0.97 - 4th-highest in the ENTIRE 248-player pool, behind only Haaland, B.Fernandes and Ekitike. Delta +7.13 (one of the largest overperformances in the game) remains an open question the model doesn't resolve, but bonus gives him a second, largely independent route to points that isn't riding on his finishing holding up. Was CAPTAIN briefly on 28 Aug (ahead of Thiago on captaincy_odds), then Sylvan moved the armband to Gabriel later the same day - conservative call after a poor GW1, not a data-driven reversal; see Gabriel's note.

squad.name: Leno
squad.selected_on: GK cover at £4.5m, 100% starts. Effectively tied with Verbruggen (xP_adj 3.36 vs 3.47) - the ILP's bench objective doesn't distinguish tied 100%-starters, so treat this as a coin-flip, not a finding.

squad.name: Virgil
squad.selected_on: Liverpool's GW1-4 DEF x is 0.69, the best defensive fixture run in the league by a distance. 100% starts, xP_adj 4.48.

squad.name: Sadiki
squad.selected_on: Bench fodder, 100% starts. Replaces Evanilson (94% starts, xP_adj 3.91) - a real downgrade in autosub value the objective doesn't price (bench value/A0.6 is not yet built), accepted here because it freed budget for the João Pedro upgrade. Corrected 28 Aug 2026: bench_order was recorded as 3 (behind Shaw) but the live site has always had him 2nd - Sadiki's 100% start rate makes that the more sensible order than Shaw's price-only bench fodder anyway, so squad.json's record was fixed to match live rather than the other way round.

squad.name: Shaw
squad.selected_on: Bench fodder - price and availability only. Unchanged since 9 Aug. Corrected 28 Aug 2026: bench_order was recorded as 2, live site has him 3rd behind Sadiki - see Sadiki's note.
